## ADDED Requirements

### Requirement: Roadmap items from two principals' roadmaps appear in one queue, each entry...

The system SHALL ensure that roadmap items from two principals' roadmaps appear in one queue, each entry attributed to its owner and source item.

#### Scenario: Roadmap items from two principals' roadmaps appear in one queue, each entry...

WHEN `team-work-queue` is implemented
THEN Roadmap items from two principals' roadmaps appear in one queue, each entry attributed to its owner and source item.

### Requirement: An agent claims the highest-priority ready entry under the declared priority...

The system SHALL ensure that an agent claims the highest-priority ready entry under the declared priority policy, independent of entry owner.

#### Scenario: An agent claims the highest-priority ready entry under the declared priority...

WHEN `team-work-queue` is implemented
THEN An agent claims the highest-priority ready entry under the declared priority policy, independent of entry owner.

### Requirement: Deleting all queue rows and re-running reconciliation reproduces the same...

The system SHALL ensure that deleting all queue rows and re-running reconciliation reproduces the same entries from git state.

#### Scenario: Deleting all queue rows and re-running reconciliation reproduces the same...

WHEN `team-work-queue` is implemented
THEN Deleting all queue rows and re-running reconciliation reproduces the same entries from git state.

### Requirement: A change to the cross-principal priority policy is accepted only from the...

The system SHALL ensure that a change to the cross-principal priority policy is accepted only from the policy's owner.

#### Scenario: A change to the cross-principal priority policy is accepted only from the...

WHEN `team-work-queue` is implemented
THEN A change to the cross-principal priority policy is accepted only from the policy's owner.

### Requirement: With a single principal and no owners.yaml, queue ordering and claim...

The system SHALL ensure that with a single principal and no owners.yaml, queue ordering and claim behavior match the pre-change behavior in the existing work-queue tests.

#### Scenario: With a single principal and no owners.yaml, queue ordering and claim...

WHEN `team-work-queue` is implemented
THEN With a single principal and no owners.yaml, queue ordering and claim behavior match the pre-change behavior in the existing work-queue tests.
